text:
maria: heads up — remote_write timeouts climbing in us-west-2a, prometheus queue length ~45k, grafana: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd/remote-write-overview
alerts-bot: [ALERT] prom_remote_write_errors firing for cluster-us-west-2a (firing)
lee: investigating logs now, can you share example target / exporter?
maria: node-exporter -> k8s nodes, noticed a new label instance_meta_id started appearing on many metrics, cardinality shot up from ~300 -> ~80k
jeff: that label was added in the relabel config from the prometheusOperator helm chart in yesterday's deploy — PR #3245
jeff: snippet:
```
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_instance_id]
  target_label: instance_meta_id
```
anand: that metadata source returns ephemeral vm ids for spot replacements, bad idea to map directly to a label
sara: what are remote_write errors showing? backoff / retries?
maria: remote_write pipeline showing 503/504 and queue_full backpressure from cortex-ingest; logs: 
```
ERRO pushing samples: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
WARN remote_write queue full, dropping oldest
```
lee: short-term mitigation: add a metric_relabel_configs entry to drop instance_meta_id before remote_write, or labeldrop on write
jeff: quick patch we can run: `kubectl patch prometheus prometheus-main -n monitoring --type merge -p '{"spec":{"metricRelabelings":[{"sourceLabels":["instance_meta_id"],"action":"labeldrop"}]}}'`
maria: applying now
alerts-bot: deploy started prometheus-main/patch by maria
maria: patched, waiting for scrape pods to recycle (prometheus-operator will apply relabels)
anand: also recommend adding a cardinality alert (e.g., `count_values("instance_meta_id", job="node-exporter") > 2000`) and a pre-deploy guard in CI
sara: we should revert the PR and add testing for label explosion in the chart upgrade path
jeff: reverted PR #3245, will follow up with a safer relabel that uses a whitelist of static ids
maria: queue length dropping back to normal, remote_write errors decreasing :thumbsup:
lee: keep the alert open for 1h and then resolve if stable
alerts-bot: [RESOLVED] prom_remote_write_errors for cluster-us-west-2a (resolved)
maria: filing a short postmortem and action items
maria: ACTIONS: [1] add cardinality guard in deploy CI; [2] permanently strip instance_meta_id via metric_relabel on prom scrape; [3] update docs on allowed metadata labels and add checklist for relabels in helm upgrades
